venue.name: Centro Cultural IV Centenario

items.information:
**The Bolivia Cubing Tour Potosi 2025** will be the Third competition of an exciting tour that will take place **in four different cities across Bolivia, between January 19 and 26**. This will be the perfect opportunity for competitors from all over the country to join a unique speedcubing experience, enjoying thrilling tournaments in various locations.
This competition is open to all public. To see all the information about register payment go to the next [Link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoliviaTourPotosi2025#53111-instrucciones-de-pago)
​
**More information about the competitions enter to: [Frequently Asked Questions / FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoliviaTourPotosi2025#53046-faq-pmf)**
​
**El Bolivia Cubing Tour Potosi 2025** será la tercera competencia de un emocionante tour que se llevará a cabo en **cuatro ciudades diferentes de Bolivia, entre el 19 y el 26 de enero**. Esta será la oportunidad perfecta para los competidores de todo el país de unirse a una experiencia única de speedcubing, disfrutando de emocionantes torneos en distintas localidades.
Esta competencia esta abierta a todo publico. Para ver la informacion acerca del pago de inscripcion entra al siguiente [Link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoliviaTourPotosi2025#53111-instrucciones-de-pago)
​
**Mas informacion acerca de las competencias ingresar a: [Preguntas frecuentes / FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoliviaTourPotosi2025#53046-faq-pmf)**

items.information:
## This competition is on a weekday!

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDWeeknightsIII2025#50919-competitor-responsibilities-faq) tab.

**Spectators can attend for free** and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [Speedcubeshop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).
